# Code Grading Suite

> Rubric and prompts for AI coding agents to grade a codebase from 1 to 10 on 35 benchmarks and improve it against those grades. Version 5.0.0. Agents: start with AGENT.md.

## Start
- [AGENT.md](AGENT.md): entry point for agents (roles, how to download and verify the suite)
- [Overview](suite/README.md): the grade, improve and review workflow

## Prompts
- [Grader](suite/prompts/grader.md): full audit prompt
- [Improver](suite/prompts/improver.md): improve code against a report
- [PR quick mode](suite/prompts/pr-review.md): grade a single change

## Rubric
- [Grader](suite/prompts/grader.md)
- [Report reviewer](suite/prompts/reviewer.md)
- [Improver](suite/prompts/improver.md)
- [PR check](suite/prompts/pr-review.md)
- [How scoring works](suite/rubric/weights.md): weights, gates, zones, targets, maturity

## Configuration
- [defaults.toml](suite/config/defaults.toml): every tunable setting, commented
- [project.example.toml](suite/config/project.example.toml): a filled-in project config
- [Tuning guide](suite/TUNING.md)

## Tools
- [gradekit.py](suite/tools/gradekit.py): report (new, finding, score, check…), validate, verify-evidence, rollup, stability, diff, calibrate, redact, rollup-repo
- [report.schema.json](suite/schema/report.schema.json)
- [Download the kit](downloads/code-grading-suite-5.0.0.zip)
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): checksums
